engine: 11tanjung's editorial acts — ONE pinned scroll-progress drives N acts that cross-fade through 4 synchronized layers at once: (1) a full-bleed IMAGE that push-zooms scale(1 -> 1+zoom) across its own window and cross-fades into the next act's image at the window seam, (2) a SPLIT-WORD HEADLINE on a 3-cell grid — two fixed italic words (left-mid, right-mid) + a large CENTRE word that SWAPS per act, (3) a small TOPLINE label that swaps per act, (4) a BODY paragraph that cross-fades per act. Carries split-word-headline (C3) as its headline layer. Harvested from D_11tanjung (C2 editorial-act-crossfade + C3 split-word-headline; 'Live with Standard -> Style -> Uncompromised').

measured_teardown.move: global progress p 0..1 over N acts; act a = floor(p*N), local t = fract(p*N). Image[a] opacity 1 + scale (1 + zoom*t); over the last `xfade` of the act's window the live image fades out (ease-out) while the next image fades in (the incoming image starts at scale 1, then becomes the live act and zooms). The centre word / topline / body for act a share the SAME opacity envelope as image[a] (one progress, four layers). The two fixed words (Live / with) never change — the grid is the constant; only the centre puant-word swaps.
measured_teardown.cited: 11tanjung C2: full-bleed image push-zoom scale 1->1.12 + crossfade onto the next; synchronously the split-headline centre word swaps (opacity), the topline label swaps, the body crossfades; ONE scroll-progress on 4 layers; ~3-3.5s scroll per act; the act runs T1/T2 twice (3 acts: Standard / Style / Uncompromised).

xfade.what: fraction of each act's window used for the crossfade tail (live act fades out, next fades in over this slice). Lower = sharper cut, higher = longer dissolve.

zoom.what: push-zoom amount per act — the live image scales 1 -> 1+zoom across its window (Ken-Burns-on-scroll). 0.12 = the 11tanjung 1->1.12.

pinFactor.what: length of the pinned scroll span (end = +innerHeight*pinFactor). ~1 viewport of scroll per act -> set ≈ act count for the 3-3.5s/act feel.

ease.what: curve applied to the crossfade in/out (and available as expo.out for a harder seam). The push-zoom itself is linear in t (a steady drift).

manageLenis.what: if true and Lenis is present, the component owns a Lenis instance + ticker; set false when the page already drives a shared Lenis (lab sets false).

entry: EditorialActCrossfade.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), acts, refresh(), destroy }. target = .eac-stage wrapping .eac-images(.eac-img[data-act] x N) + .eac-headline(.eac-fixed--l + .eac-centre(.eac-word[data-act] x N) + .eac-fixed--r) + .eac-toplines(.eac-topline[data-act]) + .eac-bodies(.eac-body[data-act]). N is read from the DOM. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub across all acts.
law: opacity (crossfade of every layer) + transform: scale (image push-zoom) only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the scrubbed images; NO WebGL; reduced-motion or <=820px -> first act shown static, no pin. owns_pin TRUE. The readability scrim is baked into each image layer (static gradient), not a separate moving surface. GSAP + ScrollTrigger required for the scroll path; set(p) works standalone for previews/snapshots.
gate_mode: owns_pin scroll-scrub. Verify the 4-layer sync (image opacity == word opacity == topline == body at every p) + the push-zoom (live image scale 1 -> 1+zoom across its window) + the crossfade seams. Drive the LAB's own pinned instance to screenshot (scroll to p*innerHeight*pinFactor); do NOT create() a second instance (two pins on one element conflict).
